text: 1、沪指全天窄幅震荡，深成指、创业板指均涨超1%。消费股集体走强，一鸣食品3连板，今世缘、安记食品等多股涨停。房地产板块拉升，京投发展3连板，滨江集团、新城控股等涨停。算力硬件股反弹，炬光科技、景旺电子、永鼎股份等涨停。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市超4100股飘红，今日成交2.17万亿。截止收盘沪指涨0.32%，深成指涨1.09%，创业板指涨1.49%。 2、板块概念方面，房地产、大消费、算力硬件、半导体芯片等板块涨幅居前，油气、煤炭、美容护理、银行等板块逆势下跌。 3、两市共3860只个股上涨，95只个股涨停，1217只个股下跌，无个股跌停，11只股票炸板
text_en: 1. The Shanghai index fluctuated narrowly throughout the day, while the Shenzhen Component Index and ChiNext Index both rose over 1%. Consumer stocks rallied broadly, with Yiming Food hitting a 3-day limit-up, and stocks such as Jinshiyuan and Anji Food also limit-up. The real estate sector moved higher, with Jingtou Development hitting a 3-day limit-up, and Binjiang Group, Seazen Holdings, and others limit-up. Computing hardware stocks rebounded, with stocks like Focuslight, Sunway Communication, and Yongding Co. hitting limit-up. More stocks rose than fell, with over 4,100 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets trading higher; today's turnover was 2.17 trillion yuan. At close, the Shanghai index rose 0.32%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 1.09%, and the ChiNext Index rose 1.49%. 2. In terms of sectors and concepts, real estate, consumer, computing hardware, and semiconductor chip sectors led gains, while oil, coal, beauty care, and banking sectors fell against the trend. 3. Across the two markets, 3,860 stocks rose, 95 hit limit-up, 1,217 fell, none hit limit-down, and 11 stocks broke their limit-up.
